title: The Palace of Hungry Stones
description: A cotton-tax collector lodges in an abandoned marble palace beside the river. Each night, the palace remembers more than it should.

rights.notes: Tagore died in 1941; the story was first published in Bengali in 1895 (collected in Golpo-Doshok). Public domain in India (life + 60 years, expired 2001) and in the US (published before 1931). Adapt from the Bengali original, not an English translation.
